blocks.text: MARAWI CITY, Lanao del Sur — The local government here has allocated P200 million for the operations of the nearly completed Marawi City General Hospital next year. Vice Mayor Majul Gandamra said the hospital, designed to accommodate 50 to 100 beds, is already 97% complete. “The local government of Marawi is ready to accept the turnover of the hospital,” he said. The hospital is being constructed using funds from the Department of Health through Task Force Bangon Marawi as part of the city’s rehabilitation program following the 2017 siege.
